scenes.stage_direction: Calls and protected interviews interrupt the search. Amara asks practical questions about Ethan's care before she asks about blame.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: She thought the family was settling a custody dispute.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Does she understand what happened now?

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: She understands that I was in the next room when she helped take him.

metadata.evidence_summary: She believed a family custody dispute was being settled.
